title: Valdare House | KEY.co
description_expanded: This 30A pet-friendly beach house rental in Inlet Beach, FL, offers a luxurious coastal retreat, perfect for families and pet owners alike. The four-bedroom, three-and-a-half-bathroom home combines the convenience of modern living with the charm of beachside relaxation. The spacious living area, fully equipped kitchen with a breakfast bar, and gas grill on the main level make it ideal for entertaining. The main bedroom features a king bed with an en suite bathroom, while the additional bedrooms, including a bunk room and a daybed room, provide ample sleeping arrangements for up to ten guests. Enjoy the outdoor amenities, such as a fantastic deck, patio seating, an outdoor shower, and a TV sitting area and bar in the garage. The inclusion of a golf cart and two electric scooters ensures effortless exploration of the picturesque surroundings. Community amenities enhance the vacation experience with a pool featuring cool water jets, an outdoor kitchen with a grill at the clubhouse, and a pool deck with a 70" TV. Just 0.4 miles from the beach access, this beach house promises easy access to the sun, sand, and sea. Complimentary high-speed Wi-Fi keeps you connected, while the mudroom provides a convenient space for beach gear. Whether starting your day with a bike ride or winding down with a sunset golf cart cruise, this Inlet Beach home offers an exquisite blend of comfort, convenience, and coastal charm for an unforgettable stay.
